definitions.explanation: An engine that generates power by burning fuel inside the engine itself, as opposed to external combustion engines like steam engines. Includes gasoline engines, diesel engines, and gas turbines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内燃機関|ないねんきかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: Most automobiles run on internal combustion engines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}→電気自動車：15581_denkijidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{内燃機関|ないねんきかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。

examples.english: By improving the efficiency of internal combustion engines, both fuel economy and emissions can be improved.

notes:
Composed of {内燃|ないねん} (internal combustion) and ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (engine, mechanism). This technical term is frequently encountered in news about the automotive industry, particularly discussions of the transition from gasoline-powered vehicles to electric vehicles. Japan's automotive industry makes this a particularly relevant topic in Japanese media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}{車|しゃ}: internal combustion engine vehicle
- {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧: phasing out of combustion engines
- {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: combustion engine development
- ⟦ガソリン→ガソリン：01346_gasorin⟧{内燃機関|ないねんきかん}: gasoline internal combustion engine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧: engine — the everyday loanword, used in casual conversation
- {外燃機関|がいねんきかん}: external combustion engine — burns fuel outside the engine (e.g., steam engine)
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧⟦モーター→モーター：23127_mootaa⟧: electric motor — the alternative powertrain replacing combustion engines
